newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Softer Tunis bourse index closes slightly up in lo.
newsitem.headline: Softer Tunis bourse index closes slightly up in lo.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Friday closed slightly up, by 0.11 percent in lower trade, bourse sources said.
The market's 30-share index closed at 592.51 from 591.88 on Thursday.
Trade volume was 1.126 million dinars against 2.843 million dinars. Exchanges on the primary market dropped to 275,491 dinars from 1.291 million dinars the previous day.
Societe Tunisienne de Banques was up 0.78 dinar to 22.73 dinars. ($1=one dinar)
